summary:
Implementation plan for single-picture products order flow:
1. Auto-select default color for products with 1 picture (or 1 color) so customers never get blocked from ordering or adding to cart.
2. Conditionally hide the interactive color selector for single-image products on ProductDetailPage, displaying a subtle informational badge 'As Shown in Photo'.
3. Guarantee Add to Cart and Buy Now succeed immediately without requiring any color interaction.
